description.value: The Mission Creamery is a family-owned, from-scratch artisan ice cream shop on Kelowna's Lakeshore Road, founded by Francine and Mike after a decade of making ice cream for family and friends. The shop crafts rotating flavors using locally sourced dairy and ingredients, with names inspired by local geography. A second outpost operates at the AQUA Boat Club, and the Lakeshore location sits along a popular cycling corridor near Okanagan Lake.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms The Mission Creamery is an active artisan ice cream shop at the OSM address (4649 Lakeshore Road, Kelowna), operated by founders Francine and Mike. Multiple flavors throughout the menu are labeled '(GF)', confirming gluten-free options; no bike parking, washroom, or water refill information appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags. The website lists two phone numbers (one in the main contact body, one in the footer) while OSM carries no phone at all.
concerns: OSM carries no phone number; website contact page lists (778) 214-0427 in the main contact body and a second number (250) 764-6171 in the site footer — it is unclear which number corresponds specifically to the Lakeshore location.
Two locations exist (Lakeshore Road and AQUA Boat Club at 450 Cook Road); the OSM record appears to represent only the Lakeshore location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible artisan ice cream shop on a cycling-friendly lakeshore corridor in Kelowna. Website is current and the business is confirmed open.

Packed lunches.detail: Menu is ice cream only — no food beyond frozen desserts

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple flavors explicitly labeled '(GF)' throughout the menu (e.g., Salted Caramel, Milk & Cookies, Chute Lake Road, matcha). No explicit vegan labeling found

wow_evidence: family-owned, from-scratch artisan ice cream shop on Kelowna's Lakeshore Road
